newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling gains on dollar, falls on pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling gains on dollar, falls on pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling gained against the dollar but fell versus the pound on Tuesday.
It exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 594.5148 versus the dollar, compared with Monday's 594.7425, the central bank said.
Against the pound, the shilling exchanged for 992.6926, down from Monday's mean of 991.3480. Dealers said they expected the dollar-shilling exchange rate to remain stable in the 590 band.
